integrity: Mathematical proof uses exact reciprocity, the published second-rank bound, and explicit concave-polynomial inequalities; finite checks are supplemental, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Odd b>=7 and third distinct inversion rank only; relies on published Proposition 2.6; cannot assert even-modulus or higher-rank cases. Historical priority is unverified independently.
title: The third inversion threshold for odd moduli: a sharp case of a Dedekind-sum conjecture
